name: pmksy_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for PMKSY irrigation authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: pmksy_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: pmksy_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for PMKSY irrigation support/subsidy based on land ownership, crop suitability, and region. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if land records unavailable, crop-region mismatch, or farmer already has active PMKSY support.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier of the land parcel.

name: pmksy_select_irrigation_type
description: Selects an irrigation type for the application. Returns system details, subsidy rates, and requirements. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if type unsupported or incompatible with land/crop.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_submit_application
description: Submits PMKSY irrigation support application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Farmer must be eligible. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve. Fails if ineligible, duplicate, or details incomplete.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

area_hectares.description: Area to be irrigated in hectares.

name: pmksy_track_application_status
description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_track_installation
description: Tracks installation_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'installed', 'verified', 'operational'). Application must be approved. Requires session_token. Does NOT install system. Fails if application not approved.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_monitor_irrigation
description: Monitors irrigation_status ('not_active', 'active', 'optimized', 'inefficient'). System must be 'operational'. Returns usage data and efficiency metrics. Requires session_token. Does NOT control irrigation. Fails if system not operational.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_get_water_availability
description: Returns water_availability_status ('unavailable', 'limited', 'available') for a location. Considers groundwater, canal, and local water body sources. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee supply. Availability varies seasonally. Fails if location invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_track_subsidy
description: Tracks subsidy_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'approved', 'disbursed', 'failed'). Subsidy released only after installation verification. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate. Fails if installation not verified.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_get_scheme_details
description: Returns PMKSY scheme details including components, subsidy rates, and eligibility criteria. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT check individual eligibility. Fails if temporarily unavailable.

name: pmksy_get_efficiency_advisory
description: Provides water optimization advisory for the installed irrigation system. Includes scheduling, maintenance, and conservation tips. Requires session_token. System must be 'operational'. Advisory does NOT guarantee improved yield. Fails if system not operational.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_schedule_inspection
description: Schedules inspection for installed irrigation system. Installation must be completed. Transitions inspection to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Fails if not installed or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_update_application
description: Updates a submitted application details. Only when 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Fails if application already under review or approved.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_raise_grievance
description: Raises PMKSY grievance. Categories: 'application_rejected', 'installation_issue', 'water_shortage', 'subsidy_not_received', 'system_failure'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmksy_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks PMKSY grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
